title: Factory AIDL signatures of 6 framework tables and the factory-only framework interfaces (CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900, PICO, Smartisan)

signature_check.tool: tools/compare-aidl-tables.py --signatures (full signature, in/out/inout, oneway per transaction of every common AIDL Proxy)

ported_signature.android.app.IBackupAgent.doFullBackup (c: PICO, factory DEX: in-place List<String> includePaths/excludePaths; BackupAgent$BackupServiceBinder -> ExtBackupAgentImpl.onFullBackup (domain:path filters, factory quirks kept), FullBackupEngine$FullBackupRunner passes the Pico task paths
ported_signature.android.bluetooth.IBluetoothPan.setBluet: CodeLinaro system/bt + BluetoothPan (mContext.getOpPackageName) + packages/apps/Bluetooth PanService; the image server is the factory Bluetooth.apk with the same (ZLjava/lang/String;)V signature
ported_signature.android.net.INetworkStatsService.forceUp: CodeLinaro: VPN accounting in NetworkStatsFactory (updateVpnInfos, adjustForTunAnd464Xlat, migrateTun with several underlying interfaces, VpnInfo.underlyingIfaces String[]), NetworkStatsService/Recorder/Observers without VpnInfo, ConnectivityService, NetworkManagementService
ported_signature.android.os.IStatsManager.sendWatchdogRol: CodeLinaro: rollbackReason/failingPackageName, PackageWatchdog failure reasons, RollbackPackageHealthObserver, AppErrors, StatsLog, statsd (StatsService, main, PowerStatsPuller, atoms.proto incl. biometric latency with LoggableMonitor/BiometricService, public StatsLog.write(int, Object...) as in the factory)
ported_signature.android.os.IVibratorService.vibrate (cod: CodeLinaro: AudioAttributes instead of usageHint, DND bypass for privileged callers, USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT in isNotification
ported_signature.android.view.ISystemGestureExclusionList: CodeLinaro: unrestricted region, exclusion restriction logging (atom 223), back gesture logging (224) in SystemUI EdgeBackGestureHandler, PointerLocationView, DeviceConfig debounce key

ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.app.ISceneInfoManager (6) / IDat: consumer and server PicoSyshub ("sceneinfo_service"), client SmartisanPowerAdvisor in sys-services; SceneInfoManager, DataListener, SceneData reconstructed
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.app.IPrefetchManager (4) / IPref: server sys-services PrefetchManagerService ("prefetch"); PrefetchInfo reconstructed, IPrefetchManagerService observer defaults; ActivityManagerSmtBase client left for the Smartisan chunk
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.os.IPowerAdvisor (15): consumers XRRuntime, PicoSyshub, OsTeaTracker, store2d (reflection); server sys-services SmartisanPowerAdvisor$BinderService ("poweradvisor")
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.com.android.internal.app.ITransferServer: consumers PicoFeedback, XRShell (reflection), sysmonitor-framework; server sysmonitor-services TransferServer ("transferserver"); AppMainMsgInfo reconstructed
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.com.android.internal.app.ISysTransServer: server sys-services SysTransServer ("systransserver"); native clients libgui/libhwui/libsysperftracker

ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.content.pm.IPackageManagerMonito: services PackageManagerServiceMonitorEx extends its Stub as in the factory; consumers sys-services/sysmonitor-services
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.os.IDeviceIdleControllerSmtEx (1: server services DeviceIdleControllerSmtEx (Smartisan chunk, not registered with ServiceManager); needed by preserved sys JARs
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.dvr.IVirtualInputService (14): explicit transaction ids (codes 2,3,5-14,16,18); "virtual_input" has no server in the factory; client SmtPCUtilsSmtBase (Smartisan chunk)
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.android.pc.ISmtPCManager (1): no service in the factory (SmtPCUtilsSmtBase.getSmtPCManager returns null); clients SmtPCUtilsSmtBase/TntManager (Smartisan chunk)
ported_factory_only_framework_jar.com.android.internal.car.ICarStatsServic: CodeLinaro; consumer is the native statsd CarStatsPuller (factory statsd strings present); no car service on PICO, statsd logs "Car service is unavailable" as on the factory

no_consumer_not_ported.android.content.IClipboardSmtEx (3): only factory framework ClipboardManagerSmtBase references it (not_needed in api-consumers.json); no server in services.jar or any sys JAR, no app
no_consumer_not_ported.android.os.IPowerManagerSmtEx (0): no reference in any factory container outside its own generated classes
no_consumer_not_ported.android.os.IPowerManagerMonitorEx (0): only framework PowerManagerMonitorEx and services PowerManagerServiceBridgeEx (both not_needed); no app or sys JAR consumer
no_consumer_not_ported.com.android.internal.telephony.ISmsSecur: CodeLinaro telephony AIDL with SmsAuthorizationRequest; no implementer or caller in CodeLinaro opt-telephony/telephony-service, factory telephony-common/services or any factory app
CodeLinaro ActiveServices client; factory vendor/product/odm have no servicetracker HAL service or VINTF entry (only sepolicy contexts and the system compatibility matrix), so every factory lookup fails (getServicetrackerInstance returns false); Source skips the lookup with the same observable result

other_boot_jars_boot_classpath_decision.com.qualcomm.qti.IPerfManager (7): QPerformance.jar (closed QTI); client com.qualcomm.qti.Performance loaded by framework BoostFramework/UxPerformance from /system/framework/QPerformance.jar, server factory /system/bin/perfservice ("vendor.perfservice"); keep the factory QPerformance/UxPerformance JARs with perfservice
other_boot_jars_boot_classpath_decision.com.qualcomm.wfd.service.ISessionManager: WfdCommon.jar (closed; CodeLinaro wfd-commonsys at the tag holds only libaac); server WfdService.apk (factory priv-app); framework consumer factory services ExtendedRemoteDisplayHelper (CodeLinaro + PICO PRODUCT_NAME_MERLINE) not in Source; keep factory WfdCommon.jar + WfdService.apk and port ExtendedRemoteDisplayHelper together
other_boot_jars_boot_classpath_decision.org.codeaurora.internal.IExtTelephony (4: telephony-ext.jar, open source: CodeLinaro platform/vendor/codeaurora/telephony internal/ (tag commit 27d00010). No "extphone" server in any factory container. Consumers: factory product Settings.apk (SettingsActivity.switchToFragment and Utils.isNetworkSettingsApkAvailable call IExtTelephony$Stub.asInterface unconditionally -> NoClassDefFoundError without the JAR), factory telephony-common CarrierServiceStateTracker, ConnectivityExt TCPBufferManager, sysmonitor-services NetworkUtilsMonitorEx. Needed on the Source BOOTCLASSPATH while the factory product Settings stays

hidden_api: All new members have the factory flags: @hide BLACKLIST defaults, public overrides WHITELIST, FreezeManager.getService/IFreezeManagerSingleton GREYLIST (config/hiddenapi-greylist.txt), StatsLog.write(int, Object...) public API as in the factory.
